name: MaryTTS
description: Component installer downloads packages from an unsigned XML manifest, MD5 from that same manifest, then loads Java classes into the running JVM.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: MaryTTS compares component archive MD5 values with its XML component descriptions. This is a content-integrity control; independent authentication of those descriptions is not established by the retained review.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical MaryTTS release under study.
The XML publisher/release-side authentication and any package-loading behavior after download were not independently audited; MD5 equality alone is not treated as publisher authentication.

original_evidence.text: | MaryTTS | https://github.com/marytts/marytts.git | f3389a19 / 2025-01-17 | Y | N (user-initiated, GUI installer) | Y | https (component list) + locations embedded per-package (scheme not enforced) | N | hash (MD5) | server-supplied/unpinned | `marytts-runtime/src/main/java/marytts/tools/install/InstallerGUI.java:183` — component list fetched from `https://raw.github.com/marytts/marytts/master/download/marytts-components.xml`; `ComponentDescription.java:668-708` downloads each component via `HttpURLConnection` from URLs listed in that same XML (`CreateComponentXML.java:250` shows the generator historically producing `http://mary.dfki.de/download/...`, i.e. plaintext-HTTP-capable); `ComponentDescription.java:781-793` computes MD5 of the downloaded archive and compares against `packageMD5` — but that MD5 is itself sourced from the same unauthenticated components XML (`packageMD5 = packageElement.getAttribute("md5sum")`, line 150). Downloaded voice/language packages are zip archives whose contents (voice `.config` + Java classes) are loaded into the running JVM's classpath at runtime — a genuine content-as-code channel. **Tier: C** (real self-updater/installer, MD5-only, unsigned manifest, unauthenticated key source — endpoint/CDN compromise of either the GitHub-raw XML or the download mirror ⇒ code load into the MaryTTS JVM). |
